decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO33 does not alter the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, cabling, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The defined interboard signal connector does not carry SPI MOSI, so its connector types and pinouts remain unchanged.
The source changes only SPI MOSI; the 5V rail remains controlled by GPIO5 and its power behavior is unaffected.
The LED standby-switching requirement uses GPIO5 for 5V_EN, not the reassigned SPI MOSI GPIO.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not change the LED supply voltage or level-shifter requirement.
The standalone USB supply topology and regulator behavior are independent of the SPI MOSI GPIO assignment.
The AXP2101 battery and USB power paths are unaffected by changing the MCU's SPI MOSI pin.
The source does not change the LED board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The currently defined sensor interfaces are I2C modules supplied at 3.3V; no SPI MOSI-dependent interface is established in this requirement.
Selecting GPIO33 for SPI MOSI does not change any component sourcing, availability, or connector-selection policy.
